name: Boiler water sampling and analysis
description: Obtain a representative, cooled sample for TDS/conductivity, pH, phosphate, silica, sulphite and iron testing without flash loss or scalding; increasingly use continuous online analysers linked to automatic blowdown and dosing control. Primary source: https://www.spiraxsarco.com/learn-about-steam/the-boiler-house/controlling-tds-in-the-boiler-water

specifications.metric: Cooled sample temperature for conductivity measurement
specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco: add phenolphthalein then 5% acetic acid drop-by-drop until colourless before measuring

specifications.metric: AC excitation frequency for boiler-water conductivity probe
specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco: high frequency needed to avoid electrolytic polarisation at high boiler-water conductivity
Spirax Sarco: do not sample from gauge glasses, external control chambers or near feedwater inlet
CEA BG04 §5: basic condensate analysis daily to prove steam quality and system health
